'''Talgo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] who served as a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Republic Army|army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" /> In [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR dates|4}}</ref> he was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] while a [[Battle of Ilum|battle]] took place there. During the battle, Talgo sold equipment from a stall in the [[Republic base camp]]. While at the stall, he wore [[Color/Legends|white]] and purple [[Armor/Legends|armor]] with a [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]]. Talgo had orange [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and brown skin and [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Talgo appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as an endgame gear vendor for Republic players on Ilum, though his rank varied throughout his time in the game.<ref name="TOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> Talgo was removed from the game.<ref name="TOR" /> His position is also marked on a map in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', a game guide released by [[Prima Games]].<ref name="Explorer">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
